reviewer: UNREVIEWED — a draft, not a curation

buildable.name: Stonehenge
buildable.justification: Trilithons and a continuous lintel ring: Column plus a lintel course. Already built as recipes/stonehenge.json, 28 090 instances from cited stone dimensions.

buildable.name: Grand-Place
buildable.justification: A closed square of guildhall facades: Wall for the elevations, Colonnade at ground level, Stair to the Town Hall. Gables are stepped Wall courses.

buildable.name: Jelling Heritage Site
buildable.justification: Two barrows as Dome, two runestones as small blocks, one church as Wall plus roof. The smallest Tier A site and the clearest test of the vocabulary.

buildable.name: The Great Wall
buildable.justification: Wall and Stair, repeated -- the primitive is the site's name. Watchtowers are Column plus Wall.

buildable.name: Memphis and its Necropolis – the Pyramid Fields from Giza to Dahshur
buildable.justification: The Giza pyramids: the Pyramid primitive, stepped in whole courses, which is what a brick pyramid honestly is.

buildable.name: Historic Centre of Rome, the Properties of the Holy See in that City Enjoying Extraterritorial Rights and San Paolo Fuori le Mura
buildable.justification: The Colosseum is Arch on Colonnade, four storeys, which is precisely what the building is. Already partly built as recipes/rom.json.

buildable.name: Acropolis of Athens
buildable.justification: The Parthenon is Colonnade plus Stair plus a pediment of stepped Wall courses.

buildable.name: Taj Mahal
buildable.justification: Dome on a plinth, four Columns as minarets, Arch iwans on each face.

buildable.name: Historic Sanctuary of Machu Picchu
buildable.justification: Terraces as Stair, buildings as Wall. worship? -- the Intihuatana is a ritual stone, not an active place of worship.

buildable.name: Borobudur Temple Compounds
buildable.justification: Stepped terraces (Stair) with stupas (Dome). worship? -- an active Buddhist pilgrimage site.

buildable.name: Cologne Cathedral
buildable.justification: Twin towers as Column, nave as Wall, the whole thing as Arch. worship? -- an active cathedral.

buildable.name: Pont du Gard
buildable.justification: Three tiers of Arch. Nothing else. The cleanest possible demonstration of one primitive.

buildable.name: Petra
buildable.justification: Rock-cut facades as Colonnade and Arch against a Wall face.

buildable.name: Angkor
buildable.justification: Towers as stepped Column, galleries as Colonnade, causeways as Wall. worship? -- parts are in active Buddhist use.

buildable.name: Chichen Itza
buildable.justification: El Castillo is the Pyramid primitive with Stair on all four faces.

buildable.name: Persepolis
buildable.justification: The Apadana is Colonnade on a Stair-approached terrace.

buildable.name: Mesa Verde National Park
buildable.justification: Cliff Palace as stacked Wall and Column under an overhang.

buildable.name: Bauhaus and its Sites in Weimar, Dessau and Bernau
buildable.justification: Wall and glazing grid as Mosaic. A modular building rendered by a modular system, which is the thesis stated twice.

buildable.name: Zollverein Coal Mine Industrial Complex
buildable.justification: Shaft 12's headframe as Column and truss, halls as Wall.

buildable.name: Speicherstadt and Kontorhaus District with Chilehaus
buildable.justification: Brick warehouses: Wall and Arch, and the single most literally brick-built site on the list.

buildable.name: Kronborg Castle
buildable.justification: Bastioned castle: Wall, Column, Stair. Hamlet's Elsinore, and Danish, which the Postillen make relevant.

buildable.name: Belfries of Belgium and France
buildable.justification: The Bruges belfry as a stepped Column. Belgian, likewise.

buildable.name: Wieliczka and Bochnia Royal Salt Mines
buildable.justification: Timbered chambers as Wall and Column. worship? -- the Chapel of St Kinga holds services.

buildable.name: Alhambra, Generalife and Albayzín, Granada
buildable.justification: Courts as Colonnade, the Court of the Lions as Column repeated, Arch throughout.

buildable.name: Mont-Saint-Michel and its Bay
buildable.justification: The abbey as Wall on a Stair-terraced rock. worship? -- an active monastic community.

buildable.name: Sydney Opera House
buildable.justification: The shells are the one site here the vocabulary genuinely strains at -- a Dome is a hemisphere and these are not. Drafted as a candidate for exactly that reason: if it cannot be built honestly it should be dropped and said so.

buildable.name: Brasília
buildable.justification: Niemeyer's Congress: Dome, inverted Dome, twin Wall slabs.

buildable.name: Rapa Nui National Park
buildable.justification: Moai as Column with a pukao course. Ahu platforms as Wall.

buildable.name: Timbuktu
buildable.justification: Djinguereber and Sankore as Wall with projecting toron. worship? -- active mosques.

buildable.name: Bagan
buildable.justification: Stupas as Dome on stepped Stair terraces, repeated at scale. worship? -- active.

buildable.name: Himeji Castle
buildable.justification: The keep as stacked Wall with tiered roofs; roofs as stepped courses.

buildable.name: Vatican City
buildable.justification: Bernini's colonnade is Colonnade, four columns deep, which is the primitive's definition. worship? -- the entire state.

buildable.name: Old Town of Segovia and its Aqueduct
buildable.justification: The aqueduct is Arch on Arch, 167 of them.

buildable.name: Ironbridge Gorge
buildable.justification: The bridge as Arch in cast iron -- the first of its kind, and the industrial rhyme to Act III.

buildable.name: Völklingen Ironworks
buildable.justification: Blast furnaces as Column and Stair. worship? -- no.

buildable.name: Sigiriya
buildable.justification: The rock as a mass, the water gardens as Mosaic, the lion staircase as Stair.

buildable.name: Archaeological Sites of the Island of Meroe
buildable.justification: Nubian pyramids: the Pyramid primitive, steeper than Giza's, repeated across a field.

buildable.name: Great Zimbabwe
buildable.justification: Dry-stone enclosures: Wall, in the most literal sense on this list -- coursed, mortarless, modular.

buildable.name: Fujian Tulou sites
buildable.justification: Circular earthen dwellings: Wall bent into a ring, which is a real test of whether the primitive can curve.

buildable.name: Citadel, Ancient City and Fortress Buildings of Derbent
buildable.justification: Wall running from the citadel to the sea.

excluded.name: Auschwitz
excluded.note: The German Nazi concentration and extermination camp. A site of industrialised mass murder is not a subject for toy bricks, under any framing.

excluded.name: Hiroshima Peace Memorial
excluded.note: The ruin left by the atomic bombing, preserved as it stood. The building is a record of the deaths beneath it.

excluded.name: Gorée
excluded.note: A centre of the Atlantic slave trade, and a memorial to it.

excluded.name: Robben Island
excluded.note: A political prison; the site is inscribed for what was done to the people held there.

excluded.name: Bikini Atoll
excluded.note: A nuclear test site: the population was displaced and the atoll is still uninhabitable.

excluded.name: Memorial sites of the Genocide: Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi and Bisesero
excluded.note: The Rwandan genocide memorials at Nyamata, Murambi, Gisozi and Bisesero. Not named in the spec; found in the snapshot, and it belongs here for exactly the same reason Auschwitz does.

excluded.name: Murambi Genocide Memorial
excluded.note: A second Rwandan record in the snapshot; excluded on its own QID so a merge or split upstream cannot quietly re-admit it.

excluded.name: Cambodian Memorial Sites: From centres of repression to places of peace and reflection
excluded.note: Centres of repression under the Khmer Rouge. Not named in the spec; found in the snapshot.
